description: This file implements a PUCCH collision manager for 5G NR scheduling, including resource allocation, collision detection, and multiplexing region management.

classes.name: pucch_collision_manager
classes.description: Manages PUCCH resource collisions, allocations, and multiplexing regions within a cell.

methods.name: make_common_resource_info
methods.description: Constructs resource_info for a common PUCCH resource based on default resource parameters.

methods.name: make_ded_resource_info
methods.description: Constructs resource_info for a dedicated PUCCH resource based on resource parameters.

methods.name: do_resources_collide
methods.description: Checks if two PUCCH resources collide based on their grants, format, and multiplexing index.

methods.name: make_cell_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of all cell resources (common and dedicated) for PUCCH scheduling.

methods.name: make_collision_matrix
methods.description: Precomputes a collision matrix indicating which resources collide.

methods.name: make_mux_regions_matrix
methods.description: Creates multiplexing regions grouping resources with identical grants and format.

methods.name: pucch_collision_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collision manager with cell configuration, resources, and matrices.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the current slot point, resetting previous slot context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears all slot contexts and resets the collision manager state.

methods.name: alloc_common
methods.description: Allocates a common PUCCH resource in the resource grid for a given slot.

methods.name: alloc_ded
methods.description: Allocates a dedicated PUCCH resource in the resource grid for a given slot.

methods.name: free_common
methods.description: Frees a common PUCCH resource in the resource grid for a given slot.

methods.name: free_ded
methods.description: Frees a dedicated PUCCH resource in the resource grid for a given slot.

methods.name: get_ded_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of a dedicated PUCCH resource based on its ID.

methods.name: build_mux_region_lookup
methods.description: Builds a lookup table mapping resources to their multiplexing regions.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Performs resource allocation with collision checks.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a resource and updates collision state.
